notes.title: UPDATE v1.03.16
notes.notes:
v1.03.16
- Added an opportunity to close inventory by pressing ESC button.
- Added settings for sensitivity of car camera.
- Added window for confirm starting new game.
- Added automatic hiding of the notification window.
- FFreelancer: Added a visual information of your skill level.
- Reduced the fuel consumption.
- SkillUP: Reduced amount of days to end course.
- Increased the running speed.
- Improved car lights.
- Improved some translation bugs.
- Fixed the gates opening.
- Fixed the bug when bought house was flicking.
- Fixed the problem with registration on FFreelancer.
- Fixed some minor bugs.

Wishlist Freelancer Life Simulator and join to our Discord server, there you can start discussing about the game or send us bug-report.
